metadata.purpose: Amplified tall accordion repro for ToggleVisibility scroll-region (symptom 1) and z-order overlap (symptom 2). Same chevron pattern as the shipped 776036215 disclaimer, but with a deliberately TALL hidden Container so the expanded body exceeds the visible area and forces a scroll region. Bottom_Sentinel must remain reachable in the accessibility tree after expand.
metadata.euiiNote: No real customer text. Generic placeholder copy only.

items.text: Section 1. This is a deliberately long disclaimer block used to force the expanded accordion content to exceed the visible area of the host cell.
Section 2. When the accordion expands, the host cell height must be re-measured so the new content is fully laid out and a scroll region is created.
Section 3. If the host cell height is not re-invalidated, the bottom of this content becomes unreachable and clipped (symptom 1).
Section 4. If the content overflows its host cell frame instead of growing the cell, it renders behind the next adaptive card in the feed (symptom 2).
Section 5. Each of these lines wraps across multiple visual rows to amplify the total expanded height well beyond a single phone screen.
Section 6. Additional padding text to push the expanded body height past the visible region of a compact iPhone layout.
Section 7. More padding text. The accessibility tree should still expose every one of these elements after expansion.
Section 8. VoiceOver users must be able to reach the final sentinel element by scrolling within the expanded region.
Section 9. Continued padding to guarantee the fitting height grows substantially on expand versus collapse.
Section 10. Final padding block before the sentinel. The sentinel below marks the very bottom of the expanded content.
Bottom sentinel — end of expanded content
